<thought>Since the initial search for a TBS‑protection template returned no results, I will look for a more general alcohol‑protection template where an aliphatic hydroxyl is transformed into a TBS ether. This matches the forward reaction that breaks an “aliphatic hydroxyls” group and forms a “t-butyldimethylsilyl” group. I will query the template catalog with those criteria.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>

  "molecule_smiles": "O[C@H]1C[C@@H](O[C@@H]([C@@H]1C)/C=C(CO)/C)C/C=C/C=C/C(O)=O",
  "functional_groups_broken": ["aliphatic hydroxyls"],
  "functional_groups_formed": ["t-butyldimethylsilyl"],
  "limit": 5
}</action_input>
